scheme_name: Share Capital to Local Entrepreneurs and Self Employed Scheme, 2008
other_conditions: Must be resident of Goa for at least 15 years
Must be below 40 years of age (relaxed by 5 years for women, disabled persons, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward Classes)
Must have passed at least the 8th standard (relaxable by the Director of Industries)
Combined annual income of applicant and spouse must not exceed ₹80,000
Cannot have availed more than 15% subsidy under any other scheme
Cannot be covered under the Kamdhenu Scheme (except for dairy/dhilling units)
benefits_summary: Provides capital contribution up to ₹2  lakh for individuals (₹3  lakh for professionals) or ₹10  lakh for groups, covering 50% of project cost.
